description.en: Same as AddParty_Message_Back, but without fading/stopping the current BGM (passes -1 for both the fade and wait durations).
Param ID of the character to add back to the party.
Whether to lock the member's position slot.
Whether to enable the member's Fighting Spirit.
Whether to lock the member's Fighting Spirit.
Level to set for the member.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

examples.case: Bringing a member back without changing their level (not found in script_clean/; invented, following the sibling functions' real usage pattern)
examples.code:
// Bring a party member back with the "rejoined" presentation, without fading the BGM, keeping their current level
AddParty_Message_NoFadeBGM_Back("para_cp0005", true, false, false);

examples.case: Bringing a member back and setting their level
examples.code:
// Bring a party member back with the "rejoined" presentation, without fading the BGM, and set their level to 18
AddParty_Message_NoFadeBGM_Back("para_cp0015", true, false, false, 18);
